claims.statement: The page covers FPT/GHEC/GHES and requires at least package read permission to view; publishers can view their publications by default. Defaults are not a verified user's actual access, package existence or full census.

Repository-scoped packages inherit repository visibility and permissions, while other registries allow personal/organization granular settings or repository linkage with inheritance. Registry class and actual inheritance must be established, not assumed from navigation.

Package pages display version publication metadata, descriptions, usage/install instructions, associated assets and download activity. Displayed metadata and examples are not independently verified provenance, safe installation, licensing clearance or successful downloads.

Repository views navigate to the repository, Packages sidebar and selected package. Organization views use Organizations, organization selection and Packages for an organization the user belongs to. These steps are not exhaustive inventory or proof of organization membership.

Personal package views use the account profile Packages tab to find published packages across organizations/repositories. No navigation or source screenshot caption proves actual package access or a complete estate census.

The GHES release-stage include is comment-only and establishes no stage. GHEC managed-user product context permits organization namespace publication, not personal storage. Outbound permission/linking/access/search guides remain separate review work; no code, installs, publications or grants executed.
